barber_chair.lore.legendary: Spun so fast one Saturday that it gave everyone in the queue a haircut at once, and they all came out looking like the barber.

bean_bag.lore.legendary: Swallowed a whole birthday party during musical statues, and nobody has moved since, so everyone won.

x_bed_frame.lore.rare: Slides one inch across the room every night, and by Friday it is under the window.
x_bed_frame.lore.epic: Dropped one inch onto its slats in the middle of a sleepover ghost story, and the room screamed and then giggled till dawn.
x_bed_frame.lore.legendary: Was carried up so many staircases on house moves that it learned to climb them, and now lets itself into the spare room.

x_headboard.lore.rare: Pops a padded button off whenever someone leans back to read, straight into their cocoa.
x_headboard.lore.epic: Thumped the wall so hard during one restless night that next door's crooked pictures all hung straight.

x_sofa_bed_frame.lore.legendary: Unfolded so far for one big family visit that it reached the kitchen, and the cousins made toast without getting up.

bench.lore.legendary: Got up one morning and walked to the seaside, because everyone who sat on it kept saying they wished they were there.

x_folding_screen.lore.epic: Fell flat during the school play costume change, and two pirates and a carrot took a very surprised bow.
x_folding_screen.lore.rare: Casts a shadow of whatever is behind it, only bigger and sillier, so the laundry pile looks like a dancing bear.

x_ladder_shelf.lore.rare: Grows an extra rung whenever someone needs more shelf space, and it is slowly reaching the ceiling.

x_magazine_rack.lore.uncommon: Curls the cover of every new magazine like a croissant, so nothing ever lies flat again.

x_spice_rack.lore.legendary: Mixed its jars so cleverly one night that it invented a new flavour, and the whole town now puts it on cornflakes.

x_wine_rack.lore.legendary: Rattled so musically during one washing machine spin that a passing band signed it up as their drummer.

x_umbrella_stand.lore.uncommon: Opens one umbrella indoors every week, just to see who gets nervous about bad luck.
x_umbrella_stand.lore.legendary: Grew so fond of umbrellas that it started borrowing them from the neighbours, and now owns every brolly in the street.

bunk_bed.lore.legendary: Was so much fun that the parents swapped and slept in it, and the children got the big bed and a lie-in.

cabinet.lore.rare: Opens its door just wide enough for one biscuit, then shuts it on the hand reaching for the second.
cabinet.lore.legendary: Collected odd lids for years until one day they all found their boxes at once, and the kitchen has never been so quiet.

coffee_table.lore.epic: Grew so many mug rings over one rainy weekend that a visitor tried to play darts on it.
coffee_table.lore.legendary: Moved so far one night that it ended up in next door's lounge, and nobody there noticed for a week.

x_bistro_table.lore.legendary: Squeezed a whole wedding breakfast onto its tiny top, plate by plate, and still had room for one croissant.

x_card_table.lore.epic: Hosted a game of snap so fierce that it slapped down a card of its own and won.
x_card_table.lore.legendary: Dealt itself a hand one night, and has been beating the whole family at cards ever since.

x_console_table.lore.epic: Held so much post over one holiday that the front door would only open an inch, and the family posted themselves in.
x_console_table.lore.legendary: Kept the hallway so tidy for so long that the hallway was promoted to a second living room.

desk.lore.legendary: Did its owner's homework one night in perfect handwriting, then got a lower mark than usual.

x_drafting_table.lore.legendary: Drew a whole new town without a single mistake, then forgot the roads, and the people are still trying to get out.

x_kitchen_counter.lore.legendary: Made breakfast all by itself one morning: perfect toast, perfect eggs, and a cup of tea for the dog.

x_nesting_tables.lore.legendary: Kept pulling out tables all through a huge party, and the last one was the size of a stamp, holding a single pea.

x_sawhorse.lore.common: Stands in the shed on four splayed legs and kicks over the paint tin whenever anyone walks past.

x_secretary_desk.lore.legendary: Hid a secret drawer so well that it found it again by accident, and was so surprised that it slammed shut for a week.

x_sit_stand_desk.lore.legendary: Rose so high one day that its owner could see over every desk in the building, and was promoted by mistake.

x_standing_desk.lore.epic: Locked itself at full height on a Friday, and the team ate lunch round it standing on one leg like flamingos.

dining_chair.lore.rare: Grows one leg slightly shorter whenever there is a guest, so the guest wobbles through the whole dinner.
dining_chair.lore.legendary: Pulled itself out for the dog one Sunday, and now the dog sits at the head of the table and expects gravy.

x_bureau.lore.legendary: Swallowed so many bills that it started writing letters of complaint to the companies itself, in ink.

dresser.lore.legendary: Matched every lost sock in the house in one night, including one from next door's washing line.

x_credenza.lore.legendary: Was so long that the office used it as a bowling lane at the summer party, and it had the best night of its life.

x_hutch.lore.rare: Rattles a polite warning whenever anyone reaches for the good cups, like a very small burglar alarm.

filing_cabinet.lore.rare: Locks its bottom drawer from the inside whenever anyone says the word urgent.
filing_cabinet.lore.legendary: Filed every paper in the building so perfectly that it filed the staff too, alphabetically, by lunchtime.

folding_chair.lore.common: Hides in the shed all winter and comes out in summer with a spider who refuses to leave.
folding_chair.lore.legendary: Was so light and snappy that the wind took it off the beach, across the bay, and it opened itself up on the other side.

four_poster.lore.legendary: Closed its curtains so tight on a stormy night that it sailed off like a ship and was docked at the seaside by breakfast.

high_chair.lore.legendary: Flicked a spoonful of yoghurt so far that it hit a dog in the next street, who came round for more.

x_rocking_horse.lore.epic: Rocked so wildly at a birthday party that the cake slid off the table and landed perfectly on the cat.
x_rocking_horse.lore.legendary: Rocked so far one night that it really reached the seaside, and came home with sand in its mane and a donkey friend.

x_towel_rail.lore.epic: Got so hot one winter morning that the bathroom turned into a sauna, and Grandad refused to come out.
x_towel_rail.lore.legendary: Hung one towel up so neatly that it never needed folding again, and the airing cupboard went on strike.

locker.lore.legendary: Opened so smoothly one exam morning that every locker in the school opened with it, and the corridor rained PE kits.

nightstand.lore.legendary: Caught a falling alarm clock, a phone and a glass of water in one night without spilling a drop, like a sleepy juggler.

picnic_table.lore.legendary: Hosted a picnic so polite that the ants formed a queue and the wasps waited to be offered a sandwich.

pool_table.lore.common: Has one leg propped on a folded birthday card, so every single ball drifts to the left.

rocking_chair.lore.legendary: Rocked so evenly that a passing orchestra used it to keep time, and it is now the band's oldest member.

sleeping_bag.lore.legendary: Zipped up so snugly on a mountain that its owner slept all winter and woke in spring next to a very confused bear.

stool.lore.rare: Grows a few inches for anyone short who sits on it, and shrinks a few for everyone else.
stool.lore.epic: Wobbled so nervously at a kitchen party that every guest held their drink with both hands, just in case.

x_bedspread.lore.legendary: Made a bed so perfectly in one flick that the hotel down the road tried to hire it as a manager.

x_bench_seat.lore.legendary: Lifted its lid one rainy day and gave back a whole lost summer: buckets, spades and a sandcastle still standing.

x_body_pillow.lore.legendary: Was hugged so hard on a stormy night that it hugged back, and its owner has never slept better or been so squashed.

x_comforter.lore.legendary: Kept a family so warm one winter that they turned the heating off, and the boiler wrote them a sad letter.

x_deckchair.lore.rare: Leans back one notch further every ten minutes until its sitter is lying flat, staring at the sky.

x_duvet_cover.lore.rare: Turns itself inside out during the night, so its sleeper wakes up inside the cover with the duvet on top.

x_folding_stool.lore.epic: Opened itself in the car boot on the way to the beach, and the family arrived with a stool where the picnic should be.
x_folding_stool.lore.legendary: Was carried up a mountain and opened at the very top, so for one minute it was the highest seat in the country.

x_footrest.lore.epic: Had so many feet put up on it at a party that it relaxed completely and started snoring under the slippers.
x_footrest.lore.legendary: Put its own feet up one evening, and the armchair had to make the tea.

x_hammock_chair.lore.uncommon: Collects every leaf, petal and lost tennis ball that drifts past, and gives them to whoever sits down next.
x_hammock_chair.lore.epic: Swayed so gently that a robin landed on it for a rest and rode it for a whole afternoon.

x_hot_water_bottle.lore.legendary: Got so cosy one snowy night that the snowman outside knocked on the window to ask for a go.

x_ottoman.lore.legendary: Opened its lid one evening and out came a lost cat, a lost dog and the uncle who popped round for tea in March.

x_papasan_chair.lore.rare: Pulls its cushion over anyone who dozes off, like a lid, and they wake up feeling like a pie.
x_papasan_chair.lore.legendary: Was so deep that a teenager went in looking for the remote and came out an hour later with three remotes and a lost hamster.

x_park_seat.lore.rare: Shuffles itself into the only shade on a hot day and into the only puddle on a wet one.
x_park_seat.lore.legendary: Was sat on by so many tired walkers that it grew a footrest, then a cup holder, and finally a little roof.

x_pet_bed.lore.legendary: Was so cosy that a fox crept in one winter night, and the family found it curled up next to the cat, both snoring.

x_piano_bench.lore.legendary: Squeaked one note so perfectly in a concert that the orchestra tuned to it.

x_pouffe.lore.uncommon: Sinks a little lower every time anyone sits on it, and is slowly turning into a rug.
x_pouffe.lore.legendary: Rolled out of the front door on a windy day and was last seen bowling along the beach, with the seagulls cheering.

x_sleep_mask.lore.rare: Shows its wearer the dream before they fall asleep, so they always know how it ends.
x_sleep_mask.lore.legendary: Kept the dawn out so well that the cockerel next door overslept too, and the whole farm had a lie-in.

x_step_stool.lore.rare: Folds itself up the moment nobody is using it and hides behind the fridge.
x_step_stool.lore.legendary: Gave a small child just enough height to see over the garden fence, and she has been in charge of the street ever since.

x_swivel_stool.lore.uncommon: Squeaks on every spin, and plays a different note for every person who sits on it.
x_swivel_stool.lore.epic: Spun so long at a kitchen party that it unscrewed itself and rose slowly towards the ceiling.
x_swivel_stool.lore.legendary: Spun so fast that it drilled down into the cellar and came back up with a jar of jam nobody knew was there.

x_throw_blanket.lore.legendary: Was thrown over the sofa so gracefully that it floated, and the cat rode it round the lounge like a flying carpet.

x_vanity_stool.lore.legendary: Got someone ready so beautifully for a party that the mirror asked for a photo.
